glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 艹 (= 艸) + phonetic 余. 茶, then slightly modified into a more conservative 茶, originates as a graphical modification of archaic 荼 (“bitter plant”), used for “tea” in classical sources. The modern version is unrelated to the bottom right component of 條.
senses: [chá] tea (beverage made by infusing tea leaves in hot water)
